How to Install Fen Light AM on Kodi (2026 Update)

May 11, 2026 / Kodi

The detailed guide below will show you How to Install the FEN/Fen Lite AM Kodi Addon with important information that will allow you to use it safely, securely, and buffer-free.

FEN is one of the most popular addon choices of all time. It provides users with a premium Kodi experience to watch high-definition films and shows on any device you prefer.

This free streaming platform has been around for years, which has helped it become one of the most widely used Kodi add-ons ever created.

Users enjoy its simplicity and high-powered source providers that pull in HD links to watch their favorite Movies/Series without any buffering.

FEN has been through numerous developers, changes, and updates to keep it functioning at a high level. Recently, a fork called Fen Light AnonyMouse (AM) took over the project but development has also stopped for that.

Fen Light AM

Millions have used the FEN addon to watch VOD within the Kodi software. However, the developer removed the official repository and halted any future updates/development for the official FEN/Fen Lite addons.

An unofficial fork known as Fen Light AM emerged as a replacement and continues to function for many users. However, active development for Fen Light AM has also slowed, and users may need to complete a few additional setup steps to get everything working properly.

This includes resetting API keys to default, clearing the addon cache, and connecting a preferred Debrid Provider (we provide instructions for this below).

IMPORTANT NOTE: The developer of Fen Light AM version available through the Red Wizard Repository recently posted a message stating that while the addon should continue working for the foreseeable future, it will likely no longer receive ongoing maintenance or updates.

Because of this, users may want to consider actively maintained alternatives such as The Gears, Umbrella, or the newly released Red Light Addon (FEN Light Clone).

In this guide, we are using an Onn 4K Pro which has quickly become the most popular Android TV device available.

These same steps also work for those using any Firestick/Fire TV device as well as Android/Google Boxes such as NVIDIA SHIELD, Google TV Streamer, and BuzzTV.

How to Install FEN Light AM Kodi Addon

Make sure to follow each step carefully so you can use this addon correctly.

Step 1 – Install Fen Light AM on Kodi

  • Open Kodi and then click Settings (Gear icon) 

  • Launch System.

  • If you do not already have Unknown Sources enabled, do this now.

  • Read the Warning message before proceeding any further

As noted, add-ons are given access to personal data stored on your Kodi device.

  • Return to the System page and this time open File Manager.

  • Click Add source.

  • Select <None>.

  • Enter https://repo.redwizard.xyz which is the official URL for this repository. Click OK.

  • Type xyz into the media source box or input any other name you prefer.

  • Go back to the System page, now select Add-ons.

  • Click Install from zip file.

  • Select “xyz” or whatever you named the media source earlier.

  • Then click repository.redwizard.zip.

  • In the upper-right-hand corner, The Red Repo add-on installed message will appear.

  • Choose Install from repository.

  • Select The Red Repo.

  • Click Video Addons.

  • Choose Fen Light AM (Unofficial).

  • Click Install.

  • You will see a success message in the corner of your screen.

Installation is now complete! However, we are not done yet as FEN Light AM requires an external provider for use.

Follow the instructions below to install and enable CocoScrapers for Movies & TV Shows.

We also provide a step-by-step guide to integrate a debrid service which is needed to stream content with Fen Light AM.

Step 2 – Install CocoScrapers Module

Just like the full version of FEN, FEN Light also requires integration of an external provider.


Try Surfshark Risk Free

We show you how to install the CocoScrapers module which works perfectly to provide streaming links.

1. After installing the addon, return to the Kodi settings page and select File Manager.

2. Click Add Source.

3. Click None.

4. Now type – https://cocojoe2411.github.io/ and click OK.

5. Type coco or other name for the media source and click OK again.

6. Return to the Settings page and click Add-ons.

7. Click install from zip file.

8. Select coco or whatever you named the media source in previous step.

9. Click repository.cocoscrapers.zip.

10. Wait for the CocoScrapers Repository Add-on installed message to appear.

11. Click install from repository.

12. Choose CocoScrapers Repository.

13. Select Program Add-ons.

14. Click CocoScrapers Module.

15. Click Install.

16. You will then see the CocoScrapers Module Add-on installed message.

CocoScrapers has now been installed! Continue reading to learn how to add a Debrid Provider and CocoScrapers to provide streaming links.

Step 3 – Reset API Keys to Default & Clear Cache

The next step is a new addition to our tutorial that requires users to reset API Keys to their default setting after the developer has stopped maintaining Fen Light.

1. Open FEN Light from your addons list.

2. Choose Tools.

3. Click Settings.

4. Choose Meta Accounts and click Client ID Key under Trakt.

5. Choose Cancel.

6. Click Yes.

7. Click Client Secret Key under Trakt.

8. Choose Cancel.

9. Click Yes.

10. Choose Restore Default Client ID Key.


Try Surfshark Risk Free

11. Click OK.

12. Select Restore Default Client Secret Key.

13. Click OK.

14. Choose API Key under TMDB API.

15. Click Cancel.

16. Select Yes.

17. Click Restore default TMDB API Key.

18. Choose OK.

19. Go back to Tools and open Database & Cache Maintenance.

20. Click Clear all cache (excluding favorites).

21. Click OK.

22. Wait for the cache to clear.

23. Click OK.

Step 4 – Set Up CocoScrapers within Fen

After clearing the cache, we will now set up the addon with the Cocoscrapers package which will scrape the internet for streaming links.

1. Click Tools.

2. Choose Settings.

3. Hover over Sources Accounts and under External Scrapers, select Enable.

4. Select Choose External Scrapers Module.

5. Click CocoScrapers Module.

6. Click OK for CocoScrapers Module success message.

We must also add a premium resolving service which we show how to do in the steps below.

Step 5 – Enable Debrid Service for FEN Light

As noted above, FEN Light AM does not work without a premium Debrid Service. In this guide, we will integrate TorBox but you can add any provider source that you prefer.

1. Open the Settings Menu, choose Sources Accounts and click Enable for TorBox.

2. Input your API Key and you will see a Success message as pictured below.

FEN Light setup is now complete!

FEN Kodi Addon Features & Description

The FEN Light Kodi add-on is filled with a great selection of popular movies and TV shows along with a simple user interface making it easy to navigate.

It is a replica of FEN so if you used to use this option, the layout will be extremely familiar!

The Categories within FEN Light consist of: Movies, TV Shows, People, Search, Discover, Random Lists, My Lists, My Services, Favorites, Downloads, & Tools.

If you are a Trakt user, you can also integrate your account within this addon which will keep all your content in sync.
